dedupe_keys.name: ice datos abiertos sector electricidad costa rica high voltage transmission lines substations and expansion plans

description: The Instituto Costarricense de Electricidad publishes an ArcGIS open data hub for the electricity sector of Costa Rica. On the day of cataloguing it listed 12 items: a transmission lines feature service with 102 high-voltage line features carrying voltage and circuit attributes, a substations service with 70 points giving name, province, canton, district and coordinates, a CAD drawing of the transmission system, a layer of ICE electricity agencies, the 2025-2030 expansion plan PDF, a link to the 2016-2035 generation expansion plan and a document on use of the open data. The line and substation metadata, from the transmission asset engineering team, state that the geodatabase is updated yearly, that features give approximate locations from airborne LiDAR surveys, and that each substation point is the centroid of its yard. Data are available free online through feature services with the usual ArcGIS download options; the transmission layers carry ICE use terms, not a named open licence. Coverage is Costa Rica. Caveats: the line and substation layers were last modified in 2022 and 2023, and the layers hold few attributes. Simulation uses are a national transmission topology for network and hazard exposure models, for example volcanic, seismic or hurricane studies. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
